features: Current manufacturer TL-2 product presents a 42 m, 3.35 m unboosted stack, three first-stage engines and an illustrated slim body with nose, bands and lower fins.
coverage.limitations: Source-dated current product family example, not an assertion that the 2023 maiden used this 42 m, three TH-12 configuration or that any future mission will do so. Provider detail reports 32.8 m, earlier engine facts and a different proposed later engine plan; preserve this disagreement rather than merging stages, dates or flight identities. Nose contour, fins, bands and stage stations are illustrative and do not assert engineering dimensions or precise flight livery.
